title: YAML error wording (24)
notes: Placeholders <v>/<text> and the anchors-vs-tags pair are matched by regex where the spec does not pin which applies.

rows.label: size
rows.line_rx:
\Aenvironment/project_config_invalid: {checkout}/.kogen/project.yaml
  (line [0-9]+: )?document\ exceeds\ the\ maximum\ size\ of\ 1048576\ bytes
\Z

pre.sh: printf 'name: kt\nchecks: []\n' > .kogen/project.yaml && head -c 1048600 /dev/zero | tr '\\0' 'x' | fold -w 1000 | sed 's/^/# /' >> .kogen/project.yaml
